name: Driver G&F
info: A reliable driver from G&F with balanced power and solid accuracy off the tee.

name: Iron 9 Klyro
info: Precision 9-iron by Klyro with excellent control on approach shots.

name: Iron 7 Mireo
info: Refined by MireO, this 7-Iron delivers precision spin with added carry. Designed for players who want controlled flight and stopping power, it offers the ideal blend of distance and finesse on approach.

name: A. Wedge Fyloe
info: Powered by FYLOE, this Approach Wedge brings strong spin with bold distance. Though it trades some accuracy and wear resistance, it's perfect for players who want to attack the pin with flair.

name: P.Wedge Royal Swing
info: The Royal Swing pitching wedge offers supreme accuracy and reliable distance control around the green.

name: Putter GolfinX
info: GolfinX's flagship putter. Unmatched precision on the green with superior feel and consistency.
